meta.policy: dither = stochastic re-draw of <spec> from the <master> copy before EVERY step (m2_bestofk sr_quantize_, arm 6 of tab:dither); rtn = same spec fixed by RTN from the same master; polish = cheap steps under the exit rule then <= polish_cap steps with the master weights until its head fires
meta.no_tensorrt_row: TensorRT engines freeze weights at build time and cannot re-round them per step; the dither policy exists in the eager path only
meta.platform: Babel L40S, one exclusive card (datacenter GPU, not edge); clocks not pinned
